fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the performance and application of the mortar, especially in structural contexts.

fields.name: seismic_approval
fields.rationale: The product is approved for seismic categories C1 and C2, which is critical for applications in earthquake-prone areas.
evidence: HIT-RE 500 V4 is ETA and ICC approved for seismic C1 and C2 category for anchoring and C1 category for rebar.

fields.name: installation_method
fields.rationale: The installation method, including the use of Hilti SAFEset and specific tools, is crucial for ensuring proper application and performance.
evidence: Hilti SAFEset is an approved system which makes anchor installation an easier, safer and faster process.
inference_basis: SAFEset system implies a specific installation method.
